<thought>This team is built around a strong offensive core with defensive pivots for the bring-6-pick-3 format. Gholdengo and Kingambit provide a powerful Steel spam duo with Good as Gold blocking status and Defog, while Dragonite and Garchomp offer versatile physical attackers with priority and speed control. Toxapex serves as a reliable defensive wall with Regenerator, and Meowscarada gives a fast pivot/revenge killer with Protean coverage.</thought>
